# Obsidian MD Opener

在 Windows 资源管理器里双击 Markdown，直接用 Obsidian 打开原文件。打开器会自动处理建库，大项目优先使用轻量仓库，本机不同仓库间可以同步快捷键、外观和常用插件设置。

Double-click Markdown files in Windows File Explorer to open them in Obsidian. The opener handles vault setup, uses a lightweight vault for large projects, and syncs common settings across local vaults.

[中文使用说明](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/blob/main/readme_ch.md) · [English guide](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/blob/main/readme_en.md) · [下载 Windows 程序 / Download for Windows](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/releases/latest/download/ObsidianMdOpener.exe)

先安装并启动一次 Obsidian，把下载的 `ObsidianMdOpener.exe` 放在固定位置，再将它设为 `.md` 文件的默认打开方式。

Install and launch Obsidian once, keep the downloaded `ObsidianMdOpener.exe` in a permanent folder, then set it as the default app for `.md` files.
